site.name: Grand Central Mine
overview: Grand Central Mine is a documented historic gold-and-silver mine in Boulder County near Jamestown.
Federal mineral records identify the Grand Central as a past producer and preserve a mapped main-entrance location in the Boulder quadrangle.

timeline.text: The Grand Central was worked as a gold-and-silver mine in Boulder County and is retained in federal mineral records as a past producer.
USGS Mineral Resources Data System records preserve the Grand Central as a named mine site with a main-entrance coordinate in the Boulder 1:24,000 quadrangle.

moreHistory: The USGS Mineral Resources Data System record for Grand Central identifies gold and silver as the documented commodities and classifies the property as a past producer.

The MRDS record gives a WGS84 main-entrance point at approximately 40.11743, -105.35845 with stated 10-meter location accuracy. Remnant uses that documented mine-level point for identification without asserting current access or condition.

USGS-derived topographic listings independently retain Grand Central Mine as a named Boulder County mine feature. A focused media search did not locate a rights-cleared photograph that could be confidently tied to this exact Boulder County site; similarly named Grand Central mines elsewhere were rejected.
